description:
[Deterministic cyber incident triage. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Evaluates operational and security incidents against regulatory materiality thresholds under DORA (JC 2023 83) and NIS2 Article 23: client impact count, downtime duration, economic loss, data compromise, and cross-border Member State impact, triggering statutory 4-hour initial and 24-hour formal notification deadlines.
Usage: Use this tool immediately upon discovering an ICT disruption to assess whether mandatory regulatory reporting to CSIRT/National Competent Authorities is required. Do NOT use for penetration test scoping (use 'tlpt_threat_led_pentest_scope').
Returns: JSON object with { isMajorIncident: boolean, notificationRequired: boolean, initialNotificationDeadlineHours: number, formalNotificationDeadlineHours: number, applicableRegimes: string[], triggeredCriteria: string[] }.

affectedService.description: Name of affected financial/ICT service or system

criticalServiceUnavailable.description: Whether a critical financial function was disrupted

dataBreachOrIntegrityLoss.description: Whether unapproved data modification or breach occurred

estimatedDirectLossEur.description: Estimated direct financial loss in EUR

incidentSummary.description: Brief description of incident impact and symptoms

isCrossBorderEuImpact.description: Whether 2 or more EU Member States are impacted

percentageOfClientsAffected.description: Percentage of active client base affected (0-100)

name: incident_severity_triage
title: Major ICT Incident Severity Triage
